title: Highest observed product default rate
so_what: Review underwriting and monitoring for this product; observed association is not causation.
caveat: Synthetic retrospective sample; at least 30 accounts per ranked cell.

title: Highest observed employment-segment default rate
so_what: Investigate affordability and repayment patterns before changing credit policy.
caveat: Synthetic retrospective sample; at least 30 accounts per ranked cell.

title: Largest observed exposure by region
so_what: Prioritize regional monitoring in proportion to outstanding exposure.
caveat: Synthetic retrospective sample; at least 30 accounts per ranked cell.

title: Highest observed age-band default rate
so_what: Use this descriptive cut for monitoring; do not infer an age-based lending rule.
caveat: Synthetic retrospective sample; at least 30 accounts per ranked cell.

title: Highest observed employment-by-income default rate
so_what: Investigate the joint affordability/employment segment; aggregate employment averages may hide this concentration.
caveat: Descriptive cross-cut, not a causal effect; at least 30 accounts.
